blocks.html: CSFP GIANT LANTERN FESTIVAL FOUNDATION INC. SIGNS UP WITH ROBINSONS MALLS. Robinsons Starmills Pampanga is the official Mall venue for the Giant Lantern Festival 2015.

In support of local artisans and domestic tourism, Robinsons Malls is once again supporting the Giant Lantern Festival 2015. This was recently announced during a formal signing of a Memorandum of Agreement (MOA) between Robinsons Starmills and CSFP Giant Lantern Festival Foundation Inc. held at Robinsons Starmills Pampanga, the official host venue of the Festival.

Now on its 107th year, the Giant Lantern Festival 2015 will showcase the Kapangpangan's creativity in producing colorful giant Christmas parols. Eleven barangays located in City of San Fernando will be participating in the Giant Lantern showdown on December 19, 2015, at Robinsons Starmills . Prior to the big day, a weeklong activities will be staged also at Robinsons Starmills Pampanga.
Shoppers and spectators will be delighted to view the Giant Lantern Display on December 19-21, December 25-30, 2015 and January 1-6, 2016 at Robinsons Starmills Rear Parking area.
